alternate_transcription.provenance: Takeshi Takahashi's transliteration via Jorge Stolfi's 1999 interlinear file, distributed by voynich.nu in IVTFF 2.0
alternate_transcription.purpose: Task79c Gate A/C: cross-transcription stability of the 13 CORE metrics; see TRANSCRIPTION_STABILITY.tsv

quarantined_for_v2_1: see F2_V2_1_CANDIDATES.md; none admitted to CORE/SUPPORTING
weights: family-balanced aggregation only (mean of family-level standardized distances); no independent per-metric weight, per FINGERPRINT_V2_DISTANCE.md section 3

methods_exercised: common-core distance (lexical paradigm, edit family, line, boundary, 2D-LITE)
pairwise-available distance (metadata-dependent families reported UNAVAILABLE for non-IVTFF controls, never imputed)

pareto_definition.purpose: dominance relationships among held-out controls only; no classifier or ranking

null_versions.pf4_leaf_paired_null: new for Task79c, PF4_LEAF_NULL.md; corrects PF4's prior inadequate HN4-based null per TASK79_B_SCOPE.md item 4; does not alter PF4's metric definition
null_versions.hr3_hr5_out_of_sample: new for Task79c, TASK79C_DESIGN.md sections 9-10; folio-block 5-fold CV, method-of-moments partial pooling

missing_data_semantics: Explicit missing class for descriptive exports; exclude missing metadata from inferential contrasts and report N (unchanged from Task79). Metadata-dependent families (locus/folio/hierarchy/cross-scale) are UNAVAILABLE, not imputed, for non-IVTFF controls (Doyle, BDD, msdos).

stability_criteria.cross_transcription: STABLE (<=1 canonical null SD, sign+status agree) / DIRECTION_STABLE (sign+status agree, >1 SD) / VERDICT_STABLE (status agrees, sign disagrees) / UNSTABLE (status disagrees) / NOT_TESTABLE, fixed in TASK79C_DESIGN.md section 2 before comparison; result: 13/13 CORE metrics STABLE or DIRECTION_STABLE, 0 UNSTABLE, 0 NOT_TESTABLE (TRANSCRIPTION_STABILITY.tsv)

control_portfolio.source: Burchards Dekret Digital, koeln-edd-c-119, CC BY 4.0; see CONTROL_PROVENANCE.tsv
MS-DOS 2.0 assembly source, full corpus + 5 matched replicates; see CONTROL_PROVENANCE.tsv

prohibited_post_freeze_changes: adding a new primary metric family to CORE/SUPPORTING without a new fingerprint version
changing any CORE/SUPPORTING metric's definition, bins, thresholds, or null family
changing family weighting after seeing a Task81-83 comparison result
retiring the LC3/LC4_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE limitation without an objectively independent locus-level data source
promoting a quarantined F2_V2_1_CANDIDATES.md entry because it discriminates well on Voynich or a Fontana-derived model
using any Fontana branch (Task76/78/80, F01/F08/F11/F12, F07/F10) output to justify any of the above
decision_basis: All Task79b-required gates (second transcription, historical notation control, table/procedural control, distance/Pareto interface exercise, corrected PF4 leaf-paired null, HR3/HR5 out-of-sample validation) completed with real data and sound estimators; see TASK79C_REPORT.md for full detail and TASK79C_DESIGN.md for the pre-registered design.
